conviction_note: Two measurements. The findings sum to +1.2. A conservative full-year product guide (the midpoint implies H2 quarters of about $218M against Q2's $239M) and a Sephience patient base still adding 300-400 a quarter point to a beat and a fourth raise. Against that, US start-form cadence has slowed from the ~140/month management called sustainable in May, and discontinuation has risen from low double digits to 20-25%; both are public since September and were part of an 11.7% slide after Q2. The scaled number is p_up 55 x abs 10 = +1.0. It is only a slight lean, because the quarterly bar rests on one estimate source (Earnings Whispers) and because this name sold a beat-and-raise last quarter (-9.94%).
bar: Q3 2026 consensus revenue $311.1M and EPS $0.17, single source: Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-10-21 (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/PTCT/21233). The same article puts FY2026 total-revenue consensus at $1.15B, below the company's $1.18-1.28B guide. The company bar is the FY2026 guide from the Q2 release of 2026-07-30: product revenue $850-950M, total $1.18-1.28B, GAAP R&D+SG&A $775-815M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001070081/000107008126000016/tmb-20260728xex99d1.htm). The quarterly bar is single-source, so the reported-quarter findings are capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 8,303,282 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 9.9% of 83.46M shares outstanding, 7.59 days to cover. It is down from 10,566,249 at 2026-07-31 and has fallen for six consecutive settlements, so shorts are covering into the print (https://equibles.com/stocks/ptct/shortinterest, read 2026-10-29). Part of the short is likely hedging for the $500M June 2026 convertible notes due 2031 (https://www.rttnews.com/3660440/ptc-therapeutics-prices-500-mln-convertible-notes-concurrently-with-2026-note-repurchase.aspx?type=alleco). There is no usable skew: the baseline chain is unusable (ATM spread 83% of mid, skew null, put/call OI 1.0, ATM IV 66.6% to the 2026-11-20 expiry). Sentiment has cooled: the stock is down 11.7% since the Q2 report, 28.6% below its 52-week high and 8% above its low, and Earnings Whispers' bullish share fell from 24.6% to 18.3%.

findings.finding: PTC's own FY2026 product guide is conservative against what it has already booked. H1 2026 net product revenue was $464.4M (Q1 $225.6M + Q2 $238.8M). The raised $850-950M guide therefore implies H2 of $386-486M, a midpoint of about $218M a quarter, below Q2's $239M. The Street's FY total-revenue consensus of $1.15B sits below the company's own $1.18-1.28B floor. A Q3 product print near the Q2 run rate would force a fourth raise or narrowing, and the market expects that only loosely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide was raised in each 2026 print. Q1 (2026-05-07), raise from $700-800M to $750-850M: +14.27%. Q2 (2026-07-30), raise to $850-950M: -9.94%, sold on decelerating Sephience growth and rising discontinuations. A raise alone does not guarantee an up move on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock has fallen 11.7% since the raise and trades 28.6% below its 52-week high, so the market is not paying for a further raise. If it were, the stock would have held near the post-Q2 high (~$75), and FY consensus would sit inside the guide rather than $30M below its floor. Partly priced: the Earnings Whispers preview names the conservatism explicitly.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview, 2026-10-21, gives the FY consensus of $1.15B below the guide and the $218M/qtr implied H2 (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/PTCT/21233). The Q1 release gives Q1 product of $225.6M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001070081/000107008126000011/tmb-20260507xex99d1.htm). Shares a document base with the next finding, but lands on a different line.

findings.finding: Sephience patient and revenue run-rate points to a Q3 product beat. Patients on commercial therapy went 946 (2025-12-31) → 1,244 (2026-03-31, +298) → 1,647 (2026-06-30, +403). Revenue per average patient fell from ~$114k to ~$105k a quarter as the international mix rose. At ~+300 net adds and ~$97-100k per patient, Q3 Sephience comes to ~$170-180M (Q2 $151.3M). With Translarna ~$35-45M, Emflaza ~$20M and other ~$20M, product revenue is ~$245-265M. The $311.1M total consensus minus ~$75M royalty implies a product bar of only ~$236M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026: Sephience $124.6M (+36% q/q), stock +14.27%. Q2 2026: Sephience $151.3M (+21% q/q), stock -9.94%. Q3 2025: revenue $211.0M vs ~$175.5M consensus, stock +5.98% despite a large EPS miss. This name trades on Sephience q/q growth, and deceleration has been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: The quarterly consensus implies product revenue roughly flat on Q2. If the market expected $245M+, the preview consensus would not sit at $311M with royalties near $75M, and the stock would not be near its post-Q2 low. This is an inference from company patient counts, not a sourced Sephience estimate. It is capped small because the bar is a single source.
findings.independence: Q1 release: patients 1,244, Sephience $124.6M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001070081/000107008126000011/tmb-20260507xex99d1.htm). The Q1 call transcript says Japan's first sale came ahead of plan and international will ramp to up to 30 countries by year-end (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/05/08/ptct-q1-2026-earnings-transcript/). The next finding cuts the other way.

findings.finding: US Sephience new-patient intake has slowed and discontinuation has risen. On the Q1 call (2026-05-08) management said US start forms ran ~140/month and called that a reasonable run rate; cumulative was 1,134 at 2025-12-31 and passed 1,500 in Q1. At the Wells Fargo and Cantor conferences (2026-09-10/11) it said only 'over 2,000' US start forms, which implies ~85-115/month since March, not 140. Discontinuation went from 'low double digits' (Q1 call) to ~20% (Q2 call) to 'stabilizing at 20-25%' (Cantor, 2026-09-11). Slower intake caps Q3 net patient adds and the Q4 exit rate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 print (-9.94%) is the precedent: Sephience growth slowed from +36% to +21% q/q and discontinuation was disclosed at ~20%, and the stock fell despite a guide raise.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it was public at three September conferences and the stock fell ~12% after Q2. What is not priced is the Q3 patient-add number that quantifies it. 'Over 2,000' is vague and could hide a number well above 2,000, which is why this is sized smaller than the Q2 reaction.
findings.independence: Wells Fargo conference summary, 2026-09-10: 'over 2,000' US start forms, discontinuation ~20% (https://quartr.com/events/ptc-therapeutics-inc-ptct-wells-fargo-21st-annual-healthcare-conference_ofWxEewH). Q1 call: ~140/month called a reasonable run rate (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/05/08/ptct-q1-2026-earnings-transcript/). Earnings Whispers notes discontinuation drifting to ~20% (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/PTCT/21233).

findings.finding: Roche's Evrysdi sales, which drive PTC's royalty line, were flat q/q in Q3. The nine-month total was CHF 1,470M (+18% CER) against H1 CHF 968M, so Q3 was CHF 502M versus CHF 504M in Q2 and CHF 464M in Q1. PTC booked $71.1M of royalty on Q2 and $70.8M in Q3 2025. As tiered royalties step up through the year, Q3 royalty revenue should be ~$70-78M: in line with or slightly above a consensus that implicitly carries ~$75M. The line is non-cash, because the royalty was sold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The royalty line has never been the driver of a PTCT reaction in the baseline window; the stock trades on Sephience.
findings.why_not_priced: A counterparty number published after PTC last spoke. It is small and non-cash, so the market has little reason to have moved on it. If it had been read as a large swing, royalty-sensitive estimates would have changed visibly, and no revision was found.
findings.independence: Roche H1 2026 release: Evrysdi CHF 968M (https://www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-2026-07-23). Roche Q1 2026: CHF 464M (https://www.roche.com/media/releases/med-cor-2026-04-23). PTC Q3 2025 royalty $70.8M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1070081/000107008125000026/tmb-20251104xex99d1.htm).

findings.finding: PTC closed the ST-920 (Fabry gene therapy) acquisition from Sangamo on 2026-09-21, inside Q3: $111M upfront plus up to $100M in approval milestones. As an asset acquisition of a BLA-stage program it will most likely be expensed as acquired IPR&D in Q3, about $1.33 a share. GAAP EPS would then print far below the $0.17 consensus, and the $775-815M GAAP opex guide may be lifted. No path to the revenue guide; it is a one-off below the product line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: PTC reported EPS of $0.20 against $1.11 consensus and the stock rose +5.98% on revenue, so headline EPS misses have been looked through on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The deal is public, so the money is priced. What may not be is whether the $0.17 EPS consensus includes the IPR&D charge. Headline algorithms could react to a large GAAP EPS miss at the release before the call. Small because the history shows EPS misses are ignored.
findings.independence: August 12, 2026 8-K: closing expected late Q3 or early Q4, $111M upfront (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001070081/000110465926095424/tmb-20260812x8k.htm). Cantor conference summary confirms the $111M upfront (https://quartr.com/events/ptc-therapeutics-inc-ptct-12th-annual-cantor-fitzgerald-global-healthcare-conference_ofWxEewK).

findings.finding: Germany's Sephience price negotiation slipped. On the Q1 call (2026-05-08) management expected it to finalize 'this summer'; at Q2 it said Q3 or Q4 2026, and at Wells Fargo (2026-09-10) it was still pending. Under Germany's GKV-FinStG the negotiated reimbursement amount applies retroactively from month 7 after launch, so a settlement in Q3 could bring a catch-up reduction for Germany sales since early 2026. Germany is a small part of the $13M international Sephience revenue in Q1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior PTCT print turned on a European price true-up. The Translarna EU non-renewal in 2025 was a larger, separate event.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether PTC has accrued for the German discount is not disclosed in the Q2 10-Q text that could be read. A booked catch-up would show as a hit to international Sephience revenue that no preview models. It is small because German volume is small and an accrual may already exist.
findings.independence: Rule on retroactive application from month 7 (https://go.pharmazie.com/blog/pharma-pricing-germany). Germany price still pending at Wells Fargo (https://quartr.com/events/ptc-therapeutics-inc-ptct-wells-fargo-21st-annual-healthcare-conference_ofWxEewH).

findings.finding: Translarna revenue is lumpy and falling. Q1 2026 was $59.0M, boosted by a large one-time Brazilian government order. Q2 2026 was $42.2M against $59.5M in Q2 2025 and $50.7M in Q3 2025. The EU conditional authorisation lapsed in 2025, the US NDA was withdrawn on 2026-02-12, and European sales continue without a licence. A Q3 with no government order could print in the $30s, a few million short of a flat assumption.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Translarna has been a secondary line since the Sephience launch. Management said guidance would be raised or narrowed depending on Translarna government orders and Emflaza erosion.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The decline is built into the guide's implied H2 (Earnings Whispers cites assumed DMD erosion). Only the order timing in Q3 is unknown.
findings.independence: Q1 call transcript on the one-time Brazil order and running Europe without a licence (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/05/08/ptct-q1-2026-earnings-transcript/). Translarna NDA withdrawal (https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/news/ptc-therapeutics-withdraws-translarna-dmd-nda/).

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is light and de-risking. Short interest fell for six straight settlements, from 10.57M (2026-07-31) to 8.30M (2026-10-15), 9.9% of shares outstanding with 7.59 days to cover. The stock is down 11.7% since Q2 and 28.6% off its 52-week high, and Earnings Whispers' bullish share fell to 18.3%. A low bar of sentiment against a guide the Street sits below.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Six of the last eight prints were up. The two down moves (-9.94% 2026-07-30, -9.89% 2025-08-07) both came off higher run-ups into the print, which is not the setup today (20d run-up -0.27%).
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the market's own state, not information it lacks. It is filed because it sets how a modest beat-and-raise would be received. If sentiment were stretched, the stock would sit near its post-Q2 range high ($75) and short interest would be rising.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-10-21 on sentiment and the post-Q2 slide (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/PTCT/21233).

findings.finding: PTC and Novartis said they would meet the FDA in 2H 2026 on whether the 24-month PIVOT-HD data (52% slowing on cUHDRS at 10 mg vs natural history) support an accelerated path for votoplam in Huntington's disease. No outcome had been disclosed as of 2026-10-29. Management's base case is the Novartis-run Phase 3 INVEST-HD (~770 patients, completion 2030). An update on the Q3 call is possible, and the payoff is skewed: an accelerated-path signal is large upside, while confirmation of the Phase 3-only path is mostly priced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The PIVOT-HD 24-month data and the INVEST-HD start (Q1/Q2 2026) were absorbed around the 2026-05-07 print (+14.27%). No FDA outcome has been reported on a call before.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether the meeting has happened is not public. If the market were pricing an accelerated path, the stock would not trade 28.6% off its high on Sephience worries alone. It is a possible disclosure, not a known one, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Q1 call: PTC and Novartis to discuss regulatory plans (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/05/08/ptct-q1-2026-earnings-transcript/). The Cantor summary of 2026-09-11 mentions no FDA meeting (https://quartr.com/events/ptc-therapeutics-inc-ptct-12th-annual-cantor-fitzgerald-global-healthcare-conference_ofWxEewK).

outside_window.finding: ST-920 rolling BLA submission for accelerated approval is to complete in Q4 2026; acceptance and a launch are 2027 events.
Vatiquinone PROVE-FA (Phase 3 open-label, ~120 patients aged 7-21) is a 24-month study supporting an NDA resubmission. ClinicalTrials.gov lists an estimated start of 2026-08-15; data are years out.

baseline_tension: There is no usable skew or option-implied move, so the only baseline signals are the 9.58% median reaction (6 of 8 up) and a flat 20-day run-up. A small long lean does not fight any market directional statement, while the post-Q2 slide and lower short interest say expectations have been reset lower.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (single-source bar): the Q3 consensus rests on Earnings Whispers alone, so the reported-quarter beat finding was capped from +1.5 to +1.0.

Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction): the Q2 beat-and-raise was sold (-9.94%), and the guide's conservatism is named in a public preview, so the guidance finding went from +1.5 to +1.2.
Lesson 5 (inference/proxy smaller): the start-form slowdown is an inference from the vague 'over 2,000', so it went from -1.5 to -1.2.
Lesson 2 (one-off sized as one-off): the ST-920 IPR&D charge went from -0.3 to -0.2; EPS misses have been looked through on this name.
Lesson 7 (positioning): short interest checked at 9.9% and falling, not crowded; no change to the negatives.
